 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SUNIL DUTTA MISHRA  ORAL ORDER 3 30-01-2026

This petition has been filed for quashing of order dated 05.07.2017 passed by learned C.J.M.,
Begusarai in connection with Begusarai Muffasil P.S. Case No.192 of 2017 whereby and whereunder cognizance was taken by the court concerned under Section 494 and 498A of I.P.C. and Sections  of Dowry Prohibition Act.
2. From the status report, it appears that the said case has already been disposed of and the accused petitioner has been acquitted on 04.03.2025.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that this case may be disposed of as it has become infructuous.
4. Learned APP for the State has no objection to this Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.48868 of 2018(3) dt.30-01-2026 prayer of the petitioner.
